prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grounded in charity, may we merit to know with him the power of the Resurrection of Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Enraizados na caridade, experimentemos com ele a força da ressurreição do Cristo.

meta.face: A lean German Capuchin of about forty-four, once a lawyer, with a FINE-BONED, NARROW face tapering to a neat chin — a high, narrow forehead, a fine, straight, narrow nose, clear, gentle hazel eyes under fine, straight brows, faint hollows under delicate cheekbones, a small, thin, kindly mouth; dark-brown hair cropped very short around the Capuchin tonsure; a full, neatly combed dark-brown beard reaching the upper chest and narrowing to a rounded point; a serene, resolute gaze toward the viewer.
meta.basis: The Pfärrenbach wall painting (Wikipedia lead) shows the usual type: a Capuchin with a long dark beard, palm and sword. The card keeps the habit, beard and palm without the weapon, and gives him a fine, narrow face of our choice for the lawyer of Freiburg, apart from Lawrence of Brindisi's broad one.
